reason: Mainly adult-orphan benefits for fallen soldiers' families; one clause extends existing one-time fertility treatment or surrogacy funding to orphans, widening funded access.
Amends Surrogacy Agreements Law to extend surrogacy eligibility beyond heterosexual couples and single women to same-sex couples and single men.
Removes regulatory age 30-41 window and 20-egg cap on egg freezing, letting any woman preserve fertility at any age and quantity.
Legislates posthumous sperm use but requires the deceased's explicit active consent, replacing presumed-will practice under Attorney General guideline; narrows access overall.
